ModMetaData.name: Universal RimTranslator
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
Translates your mods into your language, right in the game – Workshop and local mods, from and into many languages.
- Scans Defs, Keyed texts and strings of every mod and translates what is missing in your language. - Translations are written straight into the running game; no files in other mods are changed. - Names, placeholders ({0}, {PAWN_name}), colour tags and line breaks are protected; texture paths and defNames are never translated. - Everything is cached, so each text is translated only once. - Several translation services can be chained; rate limits are respected. - Manual corrections of any text are kept. - Optional offline mode (memory only), and newly added mods can wait until you let them be translated.
Note: machine translation uses online translation services; texts of your mods are sent to them.
